latest.title: Jack of All Trades, Master of the Cloud: Why Linux Powers AWS
latest.description: Linux has earned the title of "Jack of All Trades" by powering everything from web servers and containers to supercomputers and cloud platforms. But its most fascinating role might be as the foundation of AWS. In this article, we explore how Linux became the backbone of the world's leading cloud provider, why AWS relies so heavily on it, and why every aspiring cloud engineer should understand the operating system quietly powering modern innovation.

latest.title: Autonomous Instagram Automation with AWS Strands Agents, Nova Canvas & Bedrock
latest.description: This article walks through a production-grade, fully autonomous Instagram posting system built on AWS Strands Agents SDK 1.0. The system uses a multi-agent architecture where four specialized AI agents Image, Analytics, Publisher, and Slack collaborate under a master Orchestrator agent to automatically generate 4K images, craft compelling captions, post to Instagram, and notify your team on Slack, every week, without any human intervention.

trending.title: Is Node.js Still Enough? When to Move Your Backend to Rust
trending.description: Node.js remains the king of rapid development and I/O-bound tasks, but its single-threaded event loop chokes on heavy computation, while V8 garbage collection can introduce unpredictable latency spikes at scale. The answer isn't a total rewrite—it’s a hybrid architecture. Keep Node.js for your API gateway and CRUD operations, and offload CPU-heavy bottlenecks to specialized Rust microservices.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
